author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: a squat hand (short stubby fingers, the thumb only a bump) that read as a fist or a mitten. After: a taller raised hand on SQUARE with long fingers (middle tallest, outer lowest, as in the reference), a thumb that clearly juts out to the left and a rounded palm heel, so it reads as an open palm.
omissions: Four fingers become three: four 8-wide fingers plus a jutting thumb need 44 of 36 units at 8 spacing, and keeping four fingers made the thumb disappear (the fist look the reviewer rejected).
